creative_direction.name: Lapis Intarsia Night Vault
creative_direction.brief: A flat lapidary poster: deep lapis field inlaid with a fine gold star-lattice intarsia, one large hard-edge midnight octagon centred upper-middle like a vault panel behind the dome cap. The cutout is lifted into the upper two-thirds so the lower third becomes a quiet plaque band with real breathing room above it: a thin gold inlay seam, tracked brand line, then the Baskerville name set wide and centred at near band width. Stone matte against glossy blue dome and glowing amber tells the story entirely through inlay geometry.
creative_direction.material: polished lapis lazuli slab with gold star-lattice intarsia inlay
creative_direction.lighting: even shadowless frontal illumination with faint mineral glint on inlay lines, flat graphic light

background.prompt: Deep lapis blue polished stone field inlaid with a fine gold star-lattice geometric intarsia pattern, one large hard-edge darker midnight octagon panel centred upper middle, faint mineral glint on inlay lines, perfectly even shadowless illumination, no objects, no horizon

spec.lighting: even shadowless frontal illumination with faint mineral glint on inlay lines, flat graphic light
